Town Cop.description:
You are town-aligned and can investigate one player each night to learn their alignment.
Use `/investigate player-name` during the night phase in this DM with the bot.
Results will be sent as soon as the day phase starts.
You win when all Mafia and the Serial Killer are eliminated.

Town Doctor.description:
You are town-aligned and can protect one player each night from being killed.
Use `/heal player-name` during the night phase in this DM with the bot.
You win when all Mafia and the Serial Killer are eliminated.
Town Doctor.short_description: Can heal one player each night.

Plain Townie.description:
A regular member of the town.
During the day, you can use `/vote player-name` in the voting channel to cast your vote on who should be lynched.
You win when all Mafia and the Serial Killer are eliminated.

Town Role Blocker.description:
You are town-aligned and can prevent one player from performing their night action each night.
Use `/block player-name` during the night phase in this DM with the bot.
You win when all Mafia and the Serial Killer are eliminated.
Town Role Blocker.short_description: Prevents one player from performing their night action.

Godfather.description:
Chooses the Mafia's target each night.
Use `/kill player-name` in this DM with the bot.
A separate message will be sent with the identity of other Mafia members.
You win when the Mafia can no longer be eliminated.
Godfather.short_description: Chooses the Mafia's target each night.

Mob Goon.description:
A member of the Mafia.
You will be promoted to Godfather if the current one dies.
You win when the Mafia can no longer be eliminated.

Mob Role Blocker.description:
A member of the Mafia.
You can prevent one player from performing their night action each night.
Use `/block player-name` during the night phase in this DM with the bot.
You win when the Mafia can no longer be eliminated.
Mob Role Blocker.short_description: Stops a player from acting at night.

Serial Killer.description:
Kills one player each night.
Use `/kill player-name` in this DM with the bot.
You win when you are the last person standing.

Jester.description: Your goal is to get yourself lynched by the town. You have no night action.
Jester.short_description: Wins the game if they are lynched.

Vigilante.description: You are a lone wolf out for yourself. You can kill or block one player each night (your last submitted action will be used). Your goal is to be the last person standing.
Vigilante.short_description: Can kill or block. Wins by being the only survivor.

Town Cop.description:
You are the local lawman investigating gruesome disappearances.
Use `/investigate player-name` during the night phase to learn if a suspect is an innocent survivor or a killer.
You win when all evil killers are eliminated.
Town Cop.short_description: Investigates suspects during the foggy night.

Town Doctor.description:
Armed with a first-aid kit and adrenaline, you watch over the survivors.
Use `/heal player-name` during the night phase to rescue someone from a lethal ambush.
You win when the killers are defeated.

Plain Townie.description:
A terrified counselor trying to survive the night in the woods.
Cast your vote during the day using `/vote player-name` in the voting channel.
You win when all killers are dead.

Town Role Blocker.description:
You wander the grounds warning of doom, creating enough eerie commotion to halt someone in their tracks.
Use `/block player-name` during the night phase to stop their action.
You win when evil is purged.
Town Role Blocker.short_description: Distracts and blocks someone at night.

Godfather.description:
The terrifying mastermind orchestrating the cabin massacre.
Use `/kill player-name` in this DM to choose your victim each night.
You win when your cult/cabal takes over.
Godfather.short_description: Directs the horror murders each night.

Mob Goon.description:
A deranged follower serving the Slasher Mastermind.
You will take over the killings if your leader falls.
You win when evil triumphs.

Mob Role Blocker.description:
Your piercing scream paralyzes anyone in terror.
Use `/block player-name` during the night phase to freeze a victim in their tracks.
You win when evil triumphs.
Mob Role Blocker.short_description: Terrifies a player to block their action.

Serial Killer.description:
A relentless, solitary maniac stalking the camp.
Use `/kill player-name` each night to claim your prey.
You win when you are the sole survivor.

Jester.description:
You're the guy who says 'I'll be right back' and investigates the basement alone!
Your goal is to get lynched by the panicking survivors.
You win if you are lynched.
Jester.short_description: Wins if lynched by the group.

Vigilante.description:
Armed with a fire axe and pure survival instinct, you refuse to die.
Each night choose to strike (`/kill player-name`) or fortify against (`/block player-name`) an assailant.
You win by being the last survivor.
Vigilante.short_description: Determined survivor who can kill or block.

Town Cop.description:
You inspect the deepest secrets and hidden desires of club guests.
Use `/investigate player-name` at night to discover if a guest is vanilla town, part of the dominant syndicate, or an edge-lord.
You win when all hostiles are removed.

Town Doctor.description:
You provide tender aftercare, warm blankets, and emotional safety.
Use `/heal player-name` at night to protect someone from being pushed past their limits and removed from the scene.
You win when all hostiles are removed.

Plain Townie.description:
A willing and curious guest enjoying the club atmosphere.
Use `/vote player-name` during the day to vote on who gets sent to the timeout dungeon.
You win when all hostiles are removed.

Town Role Blocker.description:
You take complete control and lock a player in strict chastity for the night.
Use `/block player-name` during the night to stop their action.
You win when all hostiles are removed.
Town Role Blocker.short_description: Locks a player in chastity, blocking their action.

Godfather.description:
The commanding master who rules the VIP dungeon chambers.
Use `/kill player-name` at night to thoroughly break and eliminate a player from the scene.
You win when your syndicate takes over.

Mob Goon.description:
A loyal enforcer bound to the Supreme Dominant.
You step up to lead if your master is removed.
You win when the syndicate takes over.

Mob Role Blocker.description:
Master of ropes, shibari, and sensory deprivation.
Use `/block player-name` at night to bind a player and stop their action.
You win when the syndicate takes over.
Mob Role Blocker.short_description: Binds a player to prevent night action.

Serial Killer.description:
A rogue switch who ignores safe words and plays dangerously rough.
Use `/kill player-name` each night to eliminate everyone in the club.
You win when you are the last person standing.
Serial Killer.short_description: Ruthless rogue player aiming to eliminate all.

Jester.description:
You crave nothing more than being publicly exposed, humiliated, and punished by the crowd!
Your goal is to get voted out and tied up by the group.
You win if you are lynched.
Jester.short_description: Wins if lynched by public vote.

Vigilante.description:
A versatile free agent who shifts between dominant and submissive roles.
Each night submit `/kill player-name` to dominate or `/block player-name` to restrain.
You win by being the last person standing.
Vigilante.short_description: Free agent who can kill or block.

Town Cop.description:
You investigate dating profiles and background check potential suitors for red flags.
Use `/investigate player-name` at night to learn if they are looking for true love (Town), a toxic player (Mafia), or an unhinged commitment-phobe (Neutral).
You win when all toxic players are removed.

Town Doctor.description:
You are the ultimate emotional support bestie, armed with ice cream and dating advice!
Use `/heal player-name` at night to swoop in and prevent someone from getting their heart broken and dumped.
You win when true love triumphs over toxic players.
Town Doctor.short_description: Saves players from heartbreak and breakups.

Plain Townie.description:
A sweet, hopeful single searching for genuine love in the big city.
Use `/vote player-name` during the day to vote out the biggest dating red flags.
You win when true love wins and all toxic players are gone.

Town Role Blocker.description:
You save friends from terrible late-night decisions by crashing their awkward dates!
Use `/block player-name` at night to interrupt their plans and stop their action.
You win when all toxic players are gone.
Town Role Blocker.short_description: Interrupts a date to prevent their action.

Godfather.description:
The charismatic, smooth-talking player who leads the toxic dating circle.
Use `/kill player-name` at night to coldly dump a hopeful single and break their heart.
You win when the heartbreakers outnumber genuine singles.

Mob Goon.description:
A heartless dater who leaves people on read and ghosts after three dates.
You step up to lead the heartbreakers if your boss gets exposed.
You win when the heartbreakers take over.

Mob Role Blocker.description:
You show up uninvited to ask awkward questions and completely ruin romantic vibes.
Use `/block player-name` at night to stop a single's action.
You win when the heartbreakers take over.

Serial Killer.description:
You despise relationships and run screaming from feelings, dumping anyone who gets close!
Use `/kill player-name` each night to eliminate singles from the dating pool.
You win when you are the last single standing.
Serial Killer.short_description: Ghosts and dumps everyone to be alone.

Jester.description:
You live for chaotic public drama and messy breakup scenes!
Your goal is to be dumped in front of the entire group.
You win if you are voted out during the day.
Jester.short_description: Wins if dumped by group vote.

Vigilante.description:
Burned by love before, you navigate the dating scene on your own cynical terms.
Each night choose to break a heart (`/kill player-name`) or interrupt a date (`/block player-name`).
You win by being the last eligible single.
Vigilante.short_description: Independent single who can dump or block.

Town Cop.description:
You review expense reports and audit communications for unethical behavior.
Use `/investigate player-name` at night to see if a colleague is a loyal employee, a ruthless downsizing exec, or a rogue poacher.
You win when the workforce is saved from layoffs.

Town Doctor.description:
You fight for talent, renew contracts, and shield employees from corporate pink slips!
Use `/heal player-name` at night to protect a coworker from being fired or made redundant.
You win when the company is protected.

Plain Townie.description:
A hardworking salaried employee trying to survive the quarterly restructuring.
Use `/vote player-name` during the day in all-hands meetings to vote on employee terminations.
You win when all downsizing executives are ousted.

Town Role Blocker.description:
You hold the master admin passwords and can trigger a mandatory password reset or revoke access.
Use `/block player-name` at night to lock someone out of their systems.
You win when the company is saved.
Town Role Blocker.short_description: Locks out systems to block night actions.

Godfather.description:
The ruthless management consultant brought in to aggressively slash headcounts.
Use `/kill player-name` at night to issue a termination pink slip.
You win when the restructuring team dominates the company.

Mob Goon.description:
An ambitious corporate drone helping management carry out the downsizing.
You take over issuing terminations if the Partner is removed.
You win when the restructuring team takes over.
Mob Goon.short_description: Aids in carrying out corporate layoffs.

Mob Role Blocker.description:
You bury coworkers in endless requisition forms and red tape approval delays.
Use `/block player-name` at night to stall someone's corporate tasks.
You win when the restructuring team takes over.
Mob Role Blocker.short_description: Stalls a coworker with red tape.

Serial Killer.description:
A rogue executive headhunter poaching key staff and gutting departments.
Use `/kill player-name` each night to poach employees until you're the sole contractor standing.
You win when you are the last employee left.
Serial Killer.short_description: Poaches and fires everyone to be sole survivor.

Jester.description:
You've read the policy manual and your dream is a massive golden parachute redundancy package!
Your goal is to get laid off by company vote during the day.
You win if you are voted out.
Jester.short_description: Wins if terminated by company vote.

Vigilante.description:
A mercenary gig-worker answering only to your own invoice.
Each night choose to terminate (`/kill player-name`) or delay access (`/block player-name`).
You win by being the last worker left at the firm.
Vigilante.short_description: Freelancer who can terminate or block.

Town Cop.description:
You seek out heresy and dark demonic pacts across the realm.
Use `/investigate player-name` at night to uncover their true spiritual alignment.
You win when the forces of darkness are vanquished.

Town Doctor.description:
You channel divine healing radiance to ward off mortal blows.
Use `/heal player-name` at night to shield an ally from death.
You win when evil is purged.
Town Doctor.short_description: Channels divine light to heal allies.

Plain Townie.description:
A humble citizen of the kingdom.
Gather at the town square by day and use `/vote player-name` to banish dark forces.
You win when the kingdom is secure.

Town Role Blocker.description:
You captivate adventurers with enchanting songs and intoxicating ale.
Use `/block player-name` at night to distract a player from their quest.
You win when the kingdom is secure.
Town Role Blocker.short_description: Enchants and distracts a player at night.

Godfather.description:
The terrifying commander of the shadow cult.
Use `/kill player-name` at night to strike down defenders of the realm.
You win when the shadow consumes the kingdom.

Mob Goon.description:
A fanatical servant sworn to the Dark Lord.
You will ascend to lead the cult if your master falls.
You win when darkness prevails.

Mob Role Blocker.description:
You weave binding hexes and shadow wards.
Use `/block player-name` at night to stifle someone's abilities.
You win when darkness prevails.
Mob Role Blocker.short_description: Hexes a player to block their action.

Serial Killer.description:
A merciless rogue claiming dark bounties on all who breathe.
Use `/kill player-name` each night to harvest souls.
You win when you are the sole survivor.

Jester.description:
Afflicted by an ancient madness, your soul can only be freed if the realm executes you!
Your goal is to be banished or executed by public decree.
You win if you are lynched.
Jester.short_description: Wins if executed by town decree.

Vigilante.description:
A solitary hunter of the untamed wilderness.
Each night choose to loose a deadly arrow (`/kill player-name`) or lay a snaring trap (`/block player-name`).
You win by being the last survivor.
Vigilante.short_description: Solitary ranger who can kill or snare.

Town Cop.description:
You run deep neural scans and ICE-breakers to expose rogue operatives.
Use `/investigate player-name` at night to scan a citizen's alignment.
You win when the syndicate is dismantled.
Town Cop.short_description: Scans neural nets to verify alignment.

Town Doctor.description:
Armed with med-gel and nanite injectors, you repair flatlining implants.
Use `/heal player-name` at night to save someone from lethal cyber-hits.
You win when the streets are safe.

Plain Townie.description:
An everyday citizen surviving beneath the corporate monoliths.
Vote in the street council using `/vote player-name` during the day.
You win when the syndicate is eliminated.
Plain Townie.short_description: Standard resident of the neon sprawl.

Town Role Blocker.description:
You broadcast localized EMP interference that fries communications.
Use `/block player-name` at night to jam a runner's cyber-actions.
You win when the syndicate is eliminated.
Town Role Blocker.short_description: Jams comms to block night actions.

Godfather.description:
The cold-blooded corporate director pulling strings from the penthouse.
Use `/kill player-name` at night to order a cyber-assassination.
You win when the syndicate owns the district.

Mob Goon.description:
An augmented enforcer doing dirty work in the neon alleys.
You take command of the syndicate if your boss is flatlined.
You win when the syndicate takes over.

Mob Role Blocker.description:
You fry neural processors with military-grade intrusion counter-measures.
Use `/block player-name` at night to freeze a target's cyberware.
You win when the syndicate takes over.
Mob Role Blocker.short_description: Fries neural links to block actions.

Serial Killer.description:
Overclocked on illegal chrome and severed from humanity, you slaughter indiscriminately.
Use `/kill player-name` each night to rampage through the streets.
You win when you are the last survivor.
Serial Killer.short_description: Psychotic augmented killer on a rampage.

Jester.description:
A nihilistic holonet prankster seeking ultimate virality through public deletion!
Your goal is to get flatlined by public vote.
You win if you are lynched.
Jester.short_description: Wins if flatlined by public vote.

Vigilante.description:
A freelance street samurai beholden to no megacorp.
Each night choose to deploy a smart-gun (`/kill player-name`) or flashbang jammer (`/block player-name`).
You win by being the last survivor.
Vigilante.short_description: Solo mercenary who can kill or jam.

Town Cop.description:
You demand to speak to the manager and snoop through everyone's recycling bins!
Use `/investigate player-name` at night to inspect someone's neighborhood standing.
You win when all troublemakers are expelled.
Town Cop.short_description: Snoops on neighbors to verify alignment.

Town Doctor.description:
Armed with lavender oil, kale smoothies, and healing crystals, you cure mortal wounds!
Use `/heal player-name` at night to rub oils on someone and save their life.
You win when the neighborhood is peaceful.

Plain Townie.description:
Rocking white New Balances and grilling tongs, you just want peace on your lawn.
Vote during the day in the HOA meeting using `/vote player-name`.
You win when the neighborhood is safe.

Town Role Blocker.description:
You trap neighbors in relentless 45-minute pitches for solar panels and vacuum cleaners!
Use `/block player-name` at night to stall someone from doing anything else.
You win when the neighborhood is safe.
Town Role Blocker.short_description: Traps someone in an endless sales pitch.

Godfather.description:
The ruthless ruler of the Homeowners Association who fines people for blade-of-grass infractions.
Use `/kill player-name` at night to evict non-compliant residents.
You win when the HOA regime controls the suburb.

Mob Goon.description:
An aggressive volunteer enforcing HOA decrees with dry brownies.
You take over the HOA if the Overlord is ousted.
You win when the HOA regime rules.

Mob Role Blocker.description:
You stealthily unplug the neighborhood router at the worst possible moments!
Use `/block player-name` at night to cut off someone's internet connection.
You win when the HOA regime rules.
Mob Role Blocker.short_description: Cuts off WiFi to prevent night actions.

Serial Killer.description:
Riding into the night on a stolen lawnmower accompanied by pet alligators!
Use `/kill player-name` each night to cause completely unhinged chaos.
You win when you are the last person standing.

Jester.description:
You thrive on being canceled, melodramatic feuds, and getting kicked out of neighborhood groups!
Your goal is to get publicly evicted by vote.
You win if you are lynched.
Jester.short_description: Wins if voted out of the neighborhood.

Vigilante.description:
Equipped with mall katanas, smoke pellets, and tactical sunglasses.
Each night choose to strike (`/kill player-name`) or awkward-tackle (`/block player-name`).
You win by being the last survivor.

Town Cop.description:
You decipher eldritch ciphers and assess psychological decay.
Use `/investigate player-name` at night to divine if someone serves the ancient cosmic horrors.
You win when the cult is eradicated.

Town Doctor.description:
You administer laudanum and sedative draughts to preserve fragile minds from shattering.
Use `/heal player-name` at night to protect an ally from cosmic predation.
You win when the horrors are banished.

Plain Townie.description:
A terrified citizen clinging desperately to human reason in an unraveling coastal town.
Vote at town hall using `/vote player-name` during the day.
You win when the eldritch menace is purged.

Town Role Blocker.description:
You swing hypnotic pendulums and weave waking dreams.
Use `/block player-name` at night to hypnotize an investigator or cultist into inaction.
You win when the horrors are banished.

Godfather.description:
The blasphemous voice of the deep trench and ancient sea gods.
Use `/kill player-name` at night to offer sacrifices to the ancient ones.
You win when the cult drowns the town in madness.

Mob Goon.description:
A grotesque mutant born of coastal blasphemy.
You will lead the rites if the High Priest is slain.
You win when the ancient ones conquer.

Mob Role Blocker.description:
You whisper maddening incantations that shatter focus and resolve.
Use `/block player-name` at night to overwhelm a mortal's mind.
You win when the ancient ones conquer.
Mob Role Blocker.short_description: Maddens a player to block their action.

Serial Killer.description:
A writhing horror from the stars that hungers for mortal minds and flesh.
Use `/kill player-name` each night to devour all life.
You win when you are the sole entity left.

Jester.description:
The stars have aligned in your head and you must be sacrificed in the town square to awaken the sleeper!
Your goal is to get executed by public frenzy.
You win if you are lynched.
Jester.short_description: Wins if lynched by frantic townsfolk.

Vigilante.description:
Equipped with cold iron, warding salt, and a trench shotgun.
Each night choose to blast an abomination (`/kill player-name`) or erect an elder sign (`/block player-name`).
You win by being the last survivor.
Vigilante.short_description: Warded hunter who can kill or ward.
